accel-distance.name: Acceleration Distance
accel-distance.intro: Input target velocity v and uniform acceleration a, compute stopping distance d = v²/(2a) from rest, used for acceleration-segment motion planning and limit protection in robot joints or mobile platforms.

battery-runtime.name: Battery Runtime Estimator
battery-runtime.intro: Input battery capacity Ah, nominal voltage V, and load power P, estimate runtime t = (Ah·V)/P, helping robot and UAV designers select battery capacity based on mission power budget.

belt-linear-speed.name: Synchronous Belt Linear Speed Calculator
belt-linear-speed.intro: Input pulley diameter and rotational speed, compute synchronous belt linear speed from circumferential velocity formula for mechanical transmission and robot belt-drive design.

cable-tension-pulley.name: Cable Tension with Pulley Calculator
cable-tension-pulley.intro: Input load weight F, compute single-rope tension T = F/2 for an ideal fixed pulley, for cable, motor, and pulley force estimation in robot lifting mechanisms.

centripetal-speed-limit.name: Robot Turning Max Speed Calculator
centripetal-speed-limit.intro: Given maximum centripetal acceleration constraint, input turning radius and allowable acceleration to compute upper turning speed limit, preventing mobile robot sideslip.

dc-motor-back-emf.name: DC Motor Back-EMF Calculator
dc-motor-back-emf.intro: Input DC motor back-EMF constant k_e and angular velocity ω, compute E = k_e·ω for no-load voltage estimation, speed feedback, and driver voltage-budget check.

diff-drive-velocity.name: Differential Drive Linear/Angular Velocity Calculator
diff-drive-velocity.intro: Input left and right wheel speeds, compute robot overall linear and angular velocity using the differential-drive model, for wheeled mobile robot motion control and odometry.

encoder-angle-resolution.name: Encoder Angular Resolution Calculator
encoder-angle-resolution.intro: Input encoder pulses per revolution CPR (after quadrature decoding), compute minimum resolvable angle θ_min = 360°/(4·CPR) for selection and control-resolution assessment.

end-effector-reach.name: 2-Link Robot Workspace Calculator
end-effector-reach.intro: Input two link lengths, compute inner and outer reach radii of the ring-shaped workspace of a planar 2-link end-effector, to assist manipulator layout and reachable-range analysis.

forward-kinematics-2r.name: 2-Link Forward Kinematics Calculator
forward-kinematics-2r.intro: Input two joint angles and link lengths, compute end-effector (x, y) coordinates using forward-kinematics formula for robotic-arm pose resolution.

gear-ratio-speed.name: Gear Reduction Ratio to Shaft Speed Calculator
gear-ratio-speed.intro: Input motor input speed and reduction ratio (including stage counts), compute output shaft speed and optionally end-effector linear speed for robot joint and wheel-chassis transmission design.

gear-ratio-torque.name: Gear Reduction Ratio Torque Calculator
gear-ratio-torque.intro: Input motor input torque τ_in, reduction ratio GR, and transmission efficiency η, compute output torque τ_out = τ_in·GR·η to assess reduced torque against load, for joint-module torque selection.

gravity-comp-torque.name: Gravity-Compensation Torque Calculator
gravity-comp-torque.intro: Input link mass m, arm length L, pose angle θ, and gravitational acceleration g, compute required gravity-compensation torque τ = m·g·L·cosθ for robot-arm torque-feedforward control.

gripper-force.name: Gripper Holding Force Calculator
gripper-force.intro: Estimate total two-finger clamping force from drive torque and lever-arm relation, to assist robot gripper selection and grasping-stability verification.

inverse-kinematics-2r.name: 2-Link Inverse Kinematics Calculator
inverse-kinematics-2r.intro: Input target (x, y) coordinates, solve for two joint angles θ₁, θ₂ and determine whether the target is within the reachable workspace, for robot-arm path planning.

joint-angular-velocity.name: Joint Angular Velocity Calculator
joint-angular-velocity.intro: Input end-effector linear velocity v and arm length L, compute joint angular velocity ω = v/L for teaching-motion velocity decomposition.

lead-screw-speed.name: Ball-Screw Linear Speed Calculator
lead-screw-speed.intro: Input screw rotational speed and pitch, compute nut linear speed from the pitch formula for linear-module and robot feed-axis speed design.

lifting-torque.name: Load-Lifting Joint Torque Calculator
lifting-torque.intro: Compute required hold torque for a vertically lifted load from gravity and lever arm, to assist robot-joint motor selection and load-capacity verification.

linear-accel-force.name: Linear Acceleration Driving Force Calculator
linear-accel-force.intro: Input moving-platform mass m and required acceleration a, compute driving force F = m·a. Superimpose friction and slope to obtain motor thrust required for AGV and power-system design.

motor-power.name: Motor Mechanical Power Calculator
motor-power.intro: Input joint output torque τ and angular velocity ω, compute mechanical power P = τ·ω to check rated-power adequacy and assist drive-unit matching.

motor-torque-current.name: Motor Torque–Current Calculator
motor-torque-current.intro: From DC motor torque constant, compute armature current from output torque (or vice versa), for robot drive-motor matching and control-parameter tuning.

pid-controller.name: PID Controller Output Calculator
pid-controller.intro: Input proportional, integral, derivative gains and error signal, compute PID controller output in real time for robot closed-loop control parameter debugging.

rotational-inertia-torque.name: Rotational Inertia Required Torque Calculator
rotational-inertia-torque.intro: Input rotational part moment of inertia I and target angular acceleration α, compute required drive torque τ = I·α for servo selection.

servo-pwm-angle.name: Servo PWM-to-Angle Calculator
servo-pwm-angle.intro: Convert PWM pulse width to servo angle using mapping relation. Input pulse-width-range values to convert within 0–180° servo angle for servo-control debugging.

stepper-step-angle.name: Stepper Motor Step Angle Calculator
stepper-step-angle.intro: Input steps per revolution N, compute step angle θ = 360°/N for stepper-motor microstepping setup and positioning-precision design.

stereo-depth.name: Stereo Vision Depth Calculator
stereo-depth.intro: Input stereo camera focal length f (pixels), baseline B, and disparity d (pixels), compute depth Z = f·B/d for visual navigation and obstacle avoidance.

trajectory-time-linear.name: Linear Trajectory Time Calculator
trajectory-time-linear.intro: Input target displacement d and motion velocity v, compute straight-line motion time t = d/v for robot point-to-point motion beat estimation and trajectory-planning segment timing.

wheel-odometry.name: Wheeled Odometry Displacement Calculator
wheel-odometry.intro: Estimate robot pose change (displacement and heading angle) from left- and right-wheel traveled distances using differential-odometry model, for mobile-robot localization.
